services.title: NCMC Smart Card Purchase & Top-Up
services.description: Get a National Common Mobility Card (NCMC) or Namma Metro Smart Card for seamless tap-and-go travel across all 3 operational metro lines and BMTC buses.

documents.name: Govt Photo ID (Aadhaar / Voter ID / DL)
documents.note: Required only if purchasing personalized NCMC card at SBI / Canara Bank kiosks.

documents.name: Initial Cash / Digital Payment (₹50 Deposit + Top-Up)

steps.title: Visit Customer Care Counter
steps.details: Walk up to the Customer Care desk at any Namma Metro station across Purple, Green, or Yellow lines.

steps.title: Pay Deposit & Initial Balance
steps.details: Pay ₹50 refundable deposit plus desired initial balance (minimum ₹50, maximum ₹3,000).

steps.title: Top-Up Online
steps.details: Recharge anytime via Namma Metro App, Paytm, PhonePe, Google Pay, or bmrc.co.in.

steps.title: Tap & Travel with 5% Discount
steps.details: Tap card at AFC turnstile gates. 5% discount is automatically deducted from standard token fare.

services.title: WhatsApp QR Ticket Booking (+91 81055 56677)
services.description: Book single journey digital QR tickets directly inside WhatsApp without downloading any app or standing in station token queues.

steps.title: Save BMRCL WhatsApp Number
steps.details: Save official BMRCL WhatsApp bot number +91 81055 56677 in your phone contacts.

steps.title: Send 'Hi' in Chat
steps.details: Open WhatsApp and send 'Hi' or 'Namaskara' to start instant booking process.

steps.title: Select Journey & Passengers
steps.details: Choose 'QR Ticket', select your Origin and Destination stations, and passenger count.

steps.title: Pay & Receive QR Ticket
steps.details: Pay via UPI. Your valid QR ticket is delivered right in the chat to scan at AFC turnstiles.

services.title: Paytm & Namma Metro App QR Tickets
services.description: Book digital QR tickets for individual or group travel (up to 6 passengers) via Namma Metro Official App or Paytm.

documents.name: Namma Metro App or Paytm App

steps.title: Download & Open App
steps.details: Open Namma Metro Official App or Paytm App ➔ Navigate to Metro ➔ Bengaluru Metro.

steps.title: Select Route & Tickets
steps.details: Select Origin & Destination stations and number of passengers (1 to 6).

steps.title: Complete Online Payment
steps.details: Pay securely using UPI, Paytm Wallet, Debit/Credit Card, or Net Banking.

steps.title: Scan QR at AFC Gate
steps.details: Display QR code on mobile screen and scan at turnstile optical scanner.

services.title: Unlimited Travel Day Passes & Cash Deposit Refund
services.description: Purchase 1-Day, 3-Day, or 5-Day unlimited travel passes and return the pass after journey completion to claim ₹50 cash refund.

documents.name: Physical Day Pass Smart Card
documents.note: Must be surrendered at Customer Care.

steps.title: Purchase Day Pass
steps.details: Buy 1-Day (₹300), 3-Day (₹600), or 5-Day (₹900) pass at Customer Care.

steps.title: Enjoy Unlimited Metro Trips
steps.details: Travel unlimited times across Purple, Green, and Yellow lines during pass validity.

steps.title: Surrender Card & Collect ₹50
steps.details: Hand over the valid pass at any Customer Care counter to instantly receive ₹50 cash deposit refund.

services.title: Bulk Group Ticket Booking (10+ Passengers)
services.description: Organized school tours, corporate events, and large travel groups (10 to 1000+ commuters) can get bulk discounted group tickets.

documents.name: Written Application / Request Letter
documents.note: Stating travel date, origin, destination, and passenger count.

documents.name: Passenger Commuter List
documents.note: List of commuter names for security clearance.

steps.title: Submit Advance Application
steps.details: Submit written request to BMRCL at least 7 days prior to travel date.

steps.title: Get Bulk Discount Approval
steps.details: Receive 15% discount (10-99 pax), 20% discount (100-999 pax), or 25% discount (1000+ pax).

steps.title: Collect Group Ticket
steps.details: Pay approved bulk fare and collect consolidated single group ticket for easy gate passage.
